en: The CSV file has an unclosed quote; it may be cut off or edited. No rows were imported.
sl: Datoteka CSV ima nezaprt narekovaj; morda je odrezana ali urejena. Nobena vrstica ni bila uvožena.

en: The CSV file could not be opened, or it is not in the expected format of the broker's export.
sl: Datoteke CSV ni bilo mogoče odpreti ali ni v pričakovani obliki izvoza borznega posrednika.

en: A row with the wrong number of fields contains a line break inside a field; a quote is probably unclosed. No rows were imported.
sl: Vrstica z napačnim številom polj vsebuje prelom vrstice znotraj polja; narekovaj je verjetno nezaprt. Nobena vrstica ni bila uvožena.

en: The columns are separated by semicolons or tabs, not commas; the file was probably opened and saved again in a spreadsheet program. Download the export again from Trade Republic and import it unchanged. No rows were imported.
sl: Stolpci so ločeni s podpičji ali tabulatorji, ne z vejicami; datoteka je bila verjetno odprta in ponovno shranjena v programu za preglednice. Izvoz znova prenesite iz Trade Republic in ga uvozite nespremenjenega. Nobena vrstica ni bila uvožena.

en: The file is not a Trade Republic transaction export. Required columns are missing: {count} ({columns}). No rows were imported.
sl: Datoteka ni izvoz transakcij Trade Republic. Manjkajoči obvezni stolpci: {count} ({columns}). Nobena vrstica ni bila uvožena.

en: The row has a different number of fields than the header (expected {expected}, found {found}); the row was skipped.
sl: Vrstica ima drugačno število polj kot glava (pričakovano {expected}, najdeno {found}); vrstica je bila preskočena.

en: {rowCount} rows have a number with a comma or parentheses, which Trade Republic does not export; the file was probably opened and saved again in a spreadsheet program. Download the export again from Trade Republic and import it unchanged.
sl: Število vrstic s številom z vejico ali oklepaji, ki jih Trade Republic ne izvozi: {rowCount}. Datoteka je bila verjetno odprta in ponovno shranjena v programu za preglednice. Izvoz znova prenesite iz Trade Republic in ga uvozite nespremenjenega.

en: Required field 'datetime' is missing; transaction order cannot be established. The row was skipped; review the source transaction.
sl: Zahtevano polje 'datetime' manjka; vrstnega reda transakcij ni mogoče določiti. Vrstica je bila preskočena; preverite izvorno transakcijo.

en: Required field '{field}' is missing in {rowKind}; the row was skipped.
sl: Zahtevano polje '{field}' manjka (vrsta vrstice: {rowKind}); vrstica je bila preskočena.

en: Required fields 'symbol' and 'name' are missing in {rowKind}; the row was skipped.
sl: Zahtevani polji 'symbol' in 'name' manjkata (vrsta vrstice: {rowKind}); vrstica je bila preskočena.

en: Display name is missing; the identified event was retained.
sl: Prikazno ime manjka; prepoznani dogodek je bil ohranjen.

en: Asset classification is unresolved; the event was retained.
sl: Klasifikacija sredstva ni razrešena; dogodek je bil ohranjen.

en: Field 'datetime' is invalid; exact transaction order is unknown. The event retains its tax date and uses deterministic source ordering.
sl: Polje 'datetime' je neveljavno; natančen vrstni red transakcij ni znan. Dogodek ohrani davčni datum in uporablja določen vrstni red glede na vir.

en: Field '{field}' has an invalid value in {rowKind}; the row was skipped.
sl: Polje '{field}' ima neveljavno vrednost (vrsta vrstice: {rowKind}); vrstica je bila preskočena.

en: The calendar date in 'datetime' differs from 'date'; reporting uses 'date' and ordering uses that date at the default hour {defaultHour}:00:00 UTC. The original timestamp is retained. FIFO or corporate-action order may be incorrect; review the transaction order.
sl: Koledarski datum v polju 'datetime' se razlikuje od polja 'date'; poročanje uporablja 'date', vrstni red pa ta datum ob privzeti uri {defaultHour}:00:00 UTC. Izvirni časovni žig je ohranjen. Vrstni red FIFO ali korporativnih dejanj je lahko napačen; preverite vrstni red transakcij.

en: Field '{field}' is inconsistent with the trade side; the row was skipped.
sl: Polje '{field}' ni skladno z vrsto posla (nakup ali prodaja); vrstica je bila preskočena.

en: Asset classes differ for the same ISIN; events were retained with unresolved classification.
sl: Razredi sredstev se za isti ISIN razlikujejo; dogodki so bili ohranjeni z nerazrešeno klasifikacijo.

en: Field '{field}' has the wrong sign for a bond maturity row; the row was skipped.
sl: Polje '{field}' ima napačen predznak za vrstico zapadlosti obveznice; vrstica je bila preskočena.

en: Field '{field}' has a value that a bond maturity row does not use; the value was ignored and the row was kept.
sl: Polje '{field}' ima vrednost, ki je vrstica zapadlosti obveznice ne uporablja; vrednost je bila prezrta, vrstica pa ohranjena.

en: Field '{field}' does not match price x shares beyond rounding; the row was kept and the amount is not used for tax. Check that the file was not changed.
sl: Polje '{field}' se ne ujema s produktom cene in količine niti po zaokroževanju; vrstica je ohranjena, znesek pa se za davek ne uporablja. Preverite, ali datoteka ni bila spremenjena.

en: Asset classification is unresolved; the event was retained.
sl: Klasifikacija sredstva ni razrešena; dogodek je bil ohranjen.

en: Asset class '{assetClass}' was preserved, but its tax treatment is not supported yet.
sl: Razred sredstva '{assetClass}' je ohranjen, vendar njegova davčna obravnava še ni podprta.

en: This private-market row has units or a unit price. Private-market rows are not used as purchases, so these units are not in the capital-gains report. Check the row and report it yourself if needed.
sl: Ta vrstica zasebnega trga ima enote ali ceno na enoto. Vrstice zasebnega trga se ne uporabljajo kot nakupi, zato teh enot ni v poročilu o kapitalskih dobičkih. Preverite vrstico in jo po potrebi prijavite sami.

en: A maturity row is supported for bonds only; asset class '{assetClass}' is not a bond, so the row was skipped.
sl: Vrstica zapadlosti je podprta le za obveznice; razred sredstva '{assetClass}' ni obveznica, zato je bila vrstica preskočena.

en: The interest row has no verified cash-interest or bond-coupon mapping; its type must be chosen before it is reported.
sl: Vrstica obresti nima preverjene preslikave v obresti na gotovino ali kupon obveznice; pred prijavo je treba izbrati njeno vrsto.

en: Transaction type '{type}' in category '{category}' is recognized but not supported; the row was skipped.
sl: Vrsta transakcije '{type}' v kategoriji '{category}' je prepoznana, vendar ni podprta; vrstica je bila preskočena.

en: This interest transaction type is not supported; the row was skipped.
sl: Ta vrsta obrestne transakcije ni podprta; vrstica je bila preskočena.

en: Transaction type '{type}' in category '{category}' is unknown; the row was skipped.
sl: Vrsta transakcije '{type}' v kategoriji '{category}' ni znana; vrstica je bila preskočena.

en: Multiple merge inputs use the same source index; their events were not merged.
sl: Več vhodov za združevanje uporablja isti indeks vira; njihovi dogodki niso bili združeni.

en: An event has no source reference and was not merged.
sl: Dogodek nima sklica na vir in ni bil združen.

en: An event source index does not match its merge input and was not merged.
sl: Indeks vira dogodka se ne ujema z vhodom za združevanje in dogodek ni bil združen.

en: Events with the same broker transaction ID have conflicting tax-relevant data and were not merged.
sl: Dogodki z enakim ID-jem transakcije pri brokerju imajo nasprotujoče si davčno pomembne podatke in niso bili združeni.

en: The same transaction appears more than once in one file; it was counted once. Check the export for a copy error.
sl: Ista transakcija se v eni datoteki pojavi večkrat; upoštevana je bila enkrat. Preverite, ali je v izvozu napaka pri kopiranju.

en: Instrument names differ for the same identity; the earliest non-empty name is used for presentation; blank source names remain evidence.
sl: Imena instrumenta se za isto identiteto razlikujejo; za prikaz je uporabljeno najzgodnejše neprazno ime; prazna imena v virih ostanejo kot dokaz.

en: Asset classes differ for the same ISIN; the merged asset class is unknown.
sl: Razredi sredstev se za isti ISIN razlikujejo; združeni razred sredstva je neznan.

en: The value cannot be represented at the required precision or range.
sl: Vrednosti ni mogoče predstaviti z zahtevano natančnostjo ali v zahtevanem obsegu.

en: The calculation exceeds the supported integer range.
sl: Izračun presega podprti celoštevilski obseg.

en: The exchange rate is invalid.
sl: Menjalni tečaj je neveljaven.

en: The corporate action cannot preserve the position and exact basis.
sl: Korporativno dejanje ne more ohraniti stanja in natančne nabavne vrednosti.

en: Select a reporting year from {minYear} to {maxYear}.
sl: Izberite poročevalsko leto od {minYear} do {maxYear}.

en: Earlier purchase history is missing: this sale needs more units than the earlier purchases left. Add the older or missing statements.
sl: Manjka zgodovina prejšnjih nakupov: ta prodaja potrebuje več enot, kot jih je ostalo od prejšnjih nakupov. Dodajte starejše ali manjkajoče izpiske.

en: The value of the XML field {field} is outside what the FURS form allows: wrong length or format, a negative number, or characters the form does not accept. No XML file was written for this form.
sl: Vrednost polja XML {field} je zunaj tega, kar dovoljuje obrazec FURS: napačna dolžina ali oblika, negativno število ali znaki, ki jih obrazec ne sprejme. Datoteka XML za ta obrazec ni bila ustvarjena.

en: The XML file of this form could not be made because of an internal error. No XML file was written for this form; the other forms are not affected. Please report this error.
sl: Datoteke XML za ta obrazec ni bilo mogoče ustvariti zaradi notranje napake. Datoteka XML za ta obrazec ni bila ustvarjena; drugi obrazci niso prizadeti. Prosimo, prijavite to napako.

en: Sales of the asset class {assetClass} are not supported in the capital-gains report yet, so this investment's sales cannot be reported. No Doh-KDVP file was written.
sl: Prodaje razreda sredstev {assetClass} v poročilu o kapitalskih dobičkih še niso podprte, zato prodaj te naložbe ni mogoče prijaviti. Datoteka Doh-KDVP ni bila ustvarjena.

en: Private-market events have only a cash amount, without units or a price, so they are skipped and are not in the Doh-KDVP report. Check whether you have to report them yourself.
sl: Dogodki zasebnega trga imajo samo denarni znesek, brez enot ali cene, zato so preskočeni in niso v poročilu Doh-KDVP. Preverite, ali jih morate prijaviti sami.

en: Interest of a discount or zero-coupon bond that arises on a sale or maturity is not calculated yet, so the income of this bond cannot go into Doh-Obr.
sl: Obresti diskontne obveznice ali obveznice brez kupona, ki nastanejo ob prodaji ali zapadlosti, se še ne izračunajo, zato dohodka te obveznice ni mogoče vključiti v Doh-Obr.

en: The bond type was not given, so the interest of this bond on a sale or maturity cannot be calculated and its income cannot go into Doh-Obr.
sl: Vrsta obveznice ni bila podana, zato obresti te obveznice ob prodaji ali zapadlosti ni mogoče izračunati in njenega dohodka ni mogoče vključiti v Doh-Obr.

en: The asset class of this investment is missing, not recognized or differs between rows. Say whether to report it as shares or fund units, or to leave it out of the supported reports. No Doh-KDVP file was written.
sl: Razred sredstva te naložbe manjka, ni prepoznan ali se med vrsticami razlikuje. Povejte, ali jo prijaviti kot delnice ali enote sklada ali jo izpustiti iz podprtih poročil. Datoteka Doh-KDVP ni bila ustvarjena.

en: The question about the asset class of this investment was cancelled, so its sales cannot be reported. No Doh-KDVP file was written.
sl: Vprašanje o razredu sredstva te naložbe je bilo preklicano, zato njenih prodaj ni mogoče prijaviti. Datoteka Doh-KDVP ni bila ustvarjena.

en: You chose to leave this investment out of the supported reports, so it is not in the Doh-KDVP report. Report it yourself if it is taxable.
sl: Odločili ste se, da to naložbo izpustite iz podprtih poročil, zato ni v poročilu Doh-KDVP. Če je obdavčljiva, jo prijavite sami.

en: A trade of this investment has no known currency, so it cannot be converted to EUR. No Doh-KDVP file was written.
sl: Posel s to naložbo nima znane valute, zato ga ni mogoče preračunati v EUR. Datoteka Doh-KDVP ni bila ustvarjena.

en: Part of this sale was sold at a loss. Answer whether, within 30 days before or after the sale, you also bought or sold this investment anywhere that is not in your files: at another broker, in another account, or after the last day of your export. If you did, the whole open loss is treated as not deductible, and you correct it yourself in eDavki. Until you answer, no Doh-KDVP file is written.
sl: Del te prodaje je bil prodan z izgubo. Odgovorite, ali ste to naložbo v 30 dneh pred prodajo ali po njej kupovali ali prodajali tudi kje, česar ni v Vaših datotekah: pri drugem borznem posredniku, na drugem računu ali po zadnjem dnevu Vašega izvoza. Če ste jo, se celotna odprta izguba šteje kot nepriznana, popravite pa jo sami v eDavkih. Dokler ne odgovorite, datoteka Doh-KDVP ne bo ustvarjena.

en: The question about the loss of this sale was closed without an answer, so the sale cannot be reported. No Doh-KDVP file was written.
sl: Vprašanje o izgubi te prodaje je bilo zaprto brez odgovora, zato prodaje ni mogoče prijaviti. Datoteka Doh-KDVP ni bila ustvarjena.

en: A sale of this investment was made at a loss, and your files alone cannot decide whether the 30-day rule blocks the loss. This tool does not ask you, so the whole open loss was treated as not deductible (F10 false). If, within 30 days before or after the sale, you did not buy or sell this investment anywhere that is not in your files, correct it yourself in eDavki.
sl: Prodaja te naložbe je bila opravljena z izgubo, Vaše datoteke pa same ne zadoščajo za odločitev, ali pravilo navidezne odsvojitve onemogoča upoštevanje te izgube. To orodje Vas tega ne vpraša, zato je bila celotna odprta izguba upoštevana kot nepriznana (F10 false). Če te naložbe v 30 dneh pred prodajo ali po njej niste kupovali ali prodajali nikjer, česar ni v Vaših datotekah, to popravite sami v eDavkih.

en: The 30-day rule blocks more units of this sale than the sale has loss-making units within the holding period. This should not happen, so the sale cannot be reported. No Doh-KDVP file was written.
sl: Pravilo navidezne odsvojitve onemogoča upoštevanje izgube pri več enotah te prodaje, kot jih ima prodaja z izgubo v obdobju lastništva. To se ne bi smelo zgoditi, zato prodaje ni mogoče prijaviti. Datoteka Doh-KDVP ni bila ustvarjena.

en: This investment has a merger within 30 days after a sale at a loss in December. The 30-day loss rule cannot compare units across a merger, so the loss of that sale cannot be checked. No Doh-KDVP file was written.
sl: Ta naložba ima združitev družb v 30 dneh po decembrski prodaji z izgubo. Pravilo navidezne odsvojitve ne more primerjati enot pred združitvijo družb in po njej, zato izgube te prodaje ni mogoče preveriti. Datoteka Doh-KDVP ni bila ustvarjena.

en: The answer to {requestId} belongs to an earlier calculation. Answer the current question again.
sl: Odgovor na {requestId} se nanaša na prejšnji izračun. Ponovno odgovorite na trenutno vprašanje.

en: There is no open question {requestId}.
sl: Odprtega vprašanja {requestId} ni.

en: Question {requestId} was answered more than once.
sl: Na vprašanje {requestId} je bilo odgovorjeno večkrat.

en: This answer does not fit question {requestId}.
sl: Ta odgovor ne ustreza vprašanju {requestId}.

en: There is no saved answer {decisionId}.
sl: Shranjenega odgovora {decisionId} ni.

en: Deleting {decisionId} refers to an earlier calculation. Choose the answers to delete again.
sl: Brisanje {decisionId} se nanaša na prejšnji izračun. Ponovno izberite odgovore za brisanje.

en: Answer {decisionId} was named more than once.
sl: Odgovor {decisionId} je bil naveden večkrat.

en: This investment has a corporate action, such as a split, without a verified ratio. Find the announcement and enter how many new shares replace how many old shares, and the date the action took effect. Until you answer, no Doh-KDVP file is written.
sl: Ta naložba ima korporacijsko dejanje, na primer razdelitev delnic, brez preverjenega razmerja. Poiščite objavo in vnesite, koliko novih delnic nadomesti koliko starih, ter datum, ko je dejanje začelo veljati. Dokler ne odgovorite, datoteka Doh-KDVP ne bo ustvarjena.

en: The question about the ratio of this corporate action was closed without an answer, so the sales of this investment cannot be reported. No Doh-KDVP file was written.
sl: Vprašanje o razmerju tega korporacijskega dejanja je bilo zaprto brez odgovora, zato prodaj te naložbe ni mogoče prijaviti. Datoteka Doh-KDVP ni bila ustvarjena.

en: This investment has more than one corporate-action row from the same broker on the same day. It is not known whether they are one action or several, or in which order, so the sales of this investment cannot be reported. No Doh-KDVP file was written.
sl: Ta naložba ima na isti dan več vrstic korporacijskega dejanja istega borznega posrednika. Ni znano, ali gre za eno dejanje ali več in v kakšnem vrstnem redu, zato prodaj te naložbe ni mogoče prijaviti. Datoteka Doh-KDVP ni bila ustvarjena.

en: This corporate action comes after an earlier corporate action of the same investment on {earlierDate}. Its ratio is asked once the earlier action is applied. No Doh-KDVP file was written.
sl: To korporacijsko dejanje sledi prejšnjemu korporacijskemu dejanju iste naložbe dne {earlierDate}. Njegovo razmerje bo vprašano, ko bo prejšnje dejanje upoštevano. Datoteka Doh-KDVP ni bila ustvarjena.

en: The number in {field} of the answer to {requestId} must be a whole number above 0.
sl: Število v polju {field} odgovora na {requestId} mora biti celo število, večje od 0.

en: The answer to {requestId} has the same number of new and old shares, which would not change the position. Enter the ratio from the announcement.
sl: Odgovor na {requestId} ima enako število novih in starih delnic, kar ne bi spremenilo stanja. Vnesite razmerje iz objave.

en: The ratio in the answer to {requestId} gives a position that cannot be represented. Check the numbers.
sl: Razmerje v odgovoru na {requestId} da stanje, ki ga ni mogoče prikazati. Preverite števila.

en: The confirmed position in the answer to {requestId} does not match the position after the ratio. Confirm the preview again.
sl: Potrjeno stanje v odgovoru na {requestId} se ne ujema s stanjem po razmerju. Ponovno potrdite predogled.

en: The effective date in the answer to {requestId} must be from {earliestDate} to {latestDate}. Another date would put this action on the other side of another corporate action or of 31 December, or after a sale of more units than were held. Check the announcement, or close the question.
sl: Datum začetka veljavnosti v odgovoru na {requestId} mora biti med {earliestDate} in {latestDate}. Drug datum bi to dejanje postavil na drugo stran drugega korporacijskega dejanja ali 31. decembra ali za prodajo več enot, kot jih je bilo v lasti. Preverite objavo ali zaprite vprašanje.

en: On the effective date in the answer to {requestId}, no units are held just before the action. Check the announcement, or close the question.
sl: Na datum začetka veljavnosti v odgovoru na {requestId} tik pred dejanjem ni enot. Preverite objavo ali zaprite vprašanje.

en: The corporate action was applied with the ratio {newShares} new for {oldShares} old shares from {effectiveDate}, as you entered it. The broker did not supply this ratio.
sl: Korporacijsko dejanje je upoštevano z razmerjem {newShares} novih za {oldShares} starih delnic od {effectiveDate}, kot ste ga vnesli. Tega razmerja ni posredoval borzni posrednik.

en: The units after this corporate action were rounded to 8 decimals. The rounding changes the value of this investment by less than EUR 0.01 in total.
sl: Enote po tem korporacijskem dejanju so bile zaokrožene na 8 decimalnih mest. Zaokroževanje spremeni vrednost te naložbe skupaj za manj kot 0,01 EUR.

en: Rounding the units after this corporate action to 8 decimals would change the value of this investment by EUR 0.01 or more in total, so the sales of this investment cannot be reported. No Doh-KDVP file was written.
sl: Zaokrožitev enot po tem korporacijskem dejanju na 8 decimalnih mest bi vrednost te naložbe skupaj spremenila za 0,01 EUR ali več, zato prodaj te naložbe ni mogoče prijaviti. Datoteka Doh-KDVP ni bila ustvarjena.

en: After a split or reverse split the value of one unit of this investment is too large for a Doh-KDVP row, so the sales of this investment cannot be reported. No Doh-KDVP file was written.
sl: Po razdelitvi ali združitvi delnic je vrednost ene enote te naložbe prevelika za vrstico v Doh-KDVP, zato prodaj te naložbe ni mogoče prijaviti. Datoteka Doh-KDVP ni bila ustvarjena.

en: The files show no units of this investment just before its corporate action, such as a split. The history may be incomplete, so the sales of this investment cannot be reported. No Doh-KDVP file was written.
sl: Datoteke tik pred korporacijskim dejanjem, na primer razdelitvijo delnic, ne izkazujejo enot te naložbe. Zgodovina je morda nepopolna, zato prodaj te naložbe ni mogoče prijaviti. Datoteka Doh-KDVP ni bila ustvarjena.

en: This investment has split rows from different brokers at most {days} days apart. They may be one split booked on different dates or two splits, and two splits so close together are not supported yet, so the sales of this investment cannot be reported. No Doh-KDVP file was written.
sl: Ta naložba ima vrstice razdelitve delnic različnih borznih posrednikov v razmiku največ {days} dni. Lahko gre za eno razdelitev, knjiženo na različna dneva, ali za dve razdelitvi, dveh tako bližnjih razdelitev pa aplikacija še ne podpira, zato prodaj te naložbe ni mogoče prijaviti. Datoteka Doh-KDVP ni bila ustvarjena.

en: This investment has a merger. Mergers are not supported yet, so the sales of this investment cannot be reported. No Doh-KDVP file was written.
sl: Ta naložba ima združitev družb. Združitve še niso podprte, zato prodaj te naložbe ni mogoče prijaviti. Datoteka Doh-KDVP ni bila ustvarjena.

en: A sale of this investment on {saleDate} needs more units than the earlier purchases left, and a corporate action, such as a split, follows it within {days} days. The broker may have booked the action after it took effect. If it took effect on or before the sale, enter its ratio and that date. If not, close the question: earlier purchase history is then missing. Until you answer, no Doh-KDVP file is written.
sl: Prodaja te naložbe dne {saleDate} potrebuje več enot, kot jih je ostalo po prejšnjih nakupih, v {days} dneh za njo pa sledi korporacijsko dejanje, na primer razdelitev delnic. Borzni posrednik je dejanje morda knjižil šele po tem, ko je začelo veljati. Če je začelo veljati na dan prodaje ali pred njo, vnesite njegovo razmerje in ta datum. Če ni, zaprite vprašanje: potem manjka zgodovina prejšnjih nakupov. Dokler ne odgovorite, datoteka Doh-KDVP ne bo ustvarjena.

en: With the ratio and the effective date in the answer to {requestId}, a later sale needs more units than are held after the action. Check the ratio and the date in the announcement.
sl: Z razmerjem in datumom začetka veljavnosti v odgovoru na {requestId} bi poznejša prodaja potrebovala več enot, kot jih je v lasti po dejanju. Preverite razmerje in datum v objavi.

en: The file is not an ECB exchange-rate export. Required columns are missing: {count} ({columns}). No rates were loaded.
sl: Datoteka ni izvoz menjalnih tečajev ECB. Manjkajoči obvezni stolpci: {count} ({columns}). Noben tečaj ni bil naložen.

en: A row has a different number of fields than the header (expected {expected}, found {found}). No rates were loaded.
sl: Vrstica ima drugačno število polj kot glava (pričakovano {expected}, najdeno {found}). Noben tečaj ni bil naložen.

en: The rate file could not be opened or read. No rates were loaded.
sl: Datoteke s tečaji ni bilo mogoče odpreti ali prebrati. Noben tečaj ni bil naložen.

en: The column {field} must be {expected} in every row. No rates were loaded.
sl: Stolpec {field} mora biti v vsaki vrstici {expected}. Noben tečaj ni bil naložen.

en: The column CURRENCY must be a three-letter code in capital letters other than EUR. No rates were loaded.
sl: Stolpec CURRENCY mora vsebovati tričrkovno kodo z velikimi črkami, ki ni EUR. Noben tečaj ni bil naložen.

en: The column TIME_PERIOD must be a calendar date in the form YYYY-MM-DD. No rates were loaded.
sl: Stolpec TIME_PERIOD mora vsebovati koledarski datum v obliki LLLL-MM-DD. Noben tečaj ni bil naložen.

en: The column OBS_VALUE must be a positive number with at most eight decimals. No rates were loaded.
sl: Stolpec OBS_VALUE mora vsebovati pozitivno število z največ osmimi decimalkami. Noben tečaj ni bil naložen.

en: The column OBS_VALUE is empty. No rates were loaded.
sl: Stolpec OBS_VALUE je prazen. Noben tečaj ni bil naložen.

en: The file has the same currency and date more than once. No rates were loaded.
sl: Datoteka vsebuje isto valuto in isti datum večkrat. Noben tečaj ni bil naložen.

en: A rate file must cover one calendar year: it starts in {firstYear} and has a row from {foundYear}. No rates were loaded.
sl: Datoteka s tečaji mora zajemati eno koledarsko leto: začne se v letu {firstYear}, vsebuje pa vrstico iz leta {foundYear}. Noben tečaj ni bil naložen.

en: More than one rate file covers {year}. None of them was loaded.
sl: Več datotek s tečaji zajema leto {year}. Nobena ni bila naložena.

en: The file has a header but no rates. No rates were loaded.
sl: Datoteka ima glavo, vendar nima tečajev. Noben tečaj ni bil naložen.

en: The column {column} appears more than once in the header, so it is not clear which one to read. No rates were loaded.
sl: Stolpec {column} se v glavi pojavi večkrat, zato ni jasno, kateri naj se prebere. Noben tečaj ni bil naložen.

en: There is no official exchange rate for {currency} on {date}, and the ECB rate file for {year} is not loaded. Load that file. The reports that need this rate cannot be created yet.
sl: Za {currency} na dan {date} ni uradnega menjalnega tečaja, ker datoteka s tečaji ECB za leto {year} ni naložena. Naložite jo. Poročil, ki ta tečaj potrebujejo, še ni mogoče ustvariti.

en: The loaded ECB rate files have no rate for {currency} on {date} or in the days before it. Entering a rate by hand is not supported yet, so the reports that need it cannot be created.
sl: Naložene datoteke s tečaji ECB nimajo tečaja za {currency} na dan {date} ali v dneh pred njim. Ročni vnos tečaja še ni podprt, zato poročil, ki ga potrebujejo, ni mogoče ustvariti.

en: There is no official exchange rate for {currency} on {date}: the loaded ECB rate file ends on {lastDate}. Load a file that covers the whole year. The reports that need this rate cannot be created yet.
sl: Za {currency} na dan {date} ni uradnega menjalnega tečaja: naložena datoteka s tečaji ECB se konča dne {lastDate}. Naložite datoteko, ki zajema vse leto. Poročil, ki ta tečaj potrebujejo, še ni mogoče ustvariti.

en: {currency} was replaced by EUR on {euroDate}, so there is no official rate for it on {date}. The reports that need this rate cannot be created.
sl: Valuto {currency} je dne {euroDate} nadomestil evro, zato zanjo na dan {date} ni uradnega tečaja. Poročil, ki ta tečaj potrebujejo, ni mogoče ustvariti.

en: There is no ECB rate for {currency} on {date}. The last earlier ECB rate, from {rateDate}, was used. Check that this is the rate FURS expects.
sl: Za {currency} na dan {date} ni tečaja ECB. Uporabljen je zadnji prejšnji tečaj ECB z dne {rateDate}. Preverite, ali je to tečaj, ki ga pričakuje FURS.

en: The loaded ECB rate file for {year} starts on {firstDate}, not at the beginning of the year. Rates before that date are missing. Load a file that covers the whole year.
sl: Naložena datoteka s tečaji ECB za leto {year} se začne dne {firstDate}, ne na začetku leta. Tečajev pred tem dnem ni. Naložite datoteko, ki zajema vse leto.

en: The loaded ECB rate file for {year} ends on {lastDate}, before the end of the year. Rates after that date were taken from it as if the file were complete. Load a file that covers the whole year.
sl: Naložena datoteka s tečaji ECB za leto {year} se konča dne {lastDate}, pred koncem leta. Tečaji po tem dnevu so bili vzeti iz nje, kot da je datoteka popolna. Naložite datoteko, ki zajema vse leto.

en: The ECB rate files for {years} are not loaded, but investments sold in the year have trades that need rates from them. Load these files too and run again.
sl: Datoteke s tečaji ECB za leta {years} niso naložene, naložbe, prodane v letu, pa imajo posle, ki potrebujejo tečaje iz njih. Naložite tudi te datoteke in poženite znova.

en: The loaded ECB rate files for {years} end before trades of investments sold in the year. Load files that cover the whole year and run again.
sl: Naložene datoteke s tečaji ECB za leta {years} se končajo pred posli naložb, prodanih v letu. Naložite datoteke, ki zajemajo vse leto, in poženite znova.

en: A sale was reduced by less than 0.00000100 units to the units the earlier purchases left. The digits that the import discarded show that the difference is rounding. The original sale is kept.
sl: Prodaja je bila zmanjšana za manj kot 0,00000100 enote na enote, ki so ostale od prejšnjih nakupov. Števke, ki jih je uvoz zavrgel, kažejo, da gre za zaokroževanje. Izvirna prodaja ostane shranjena.

en: A sale was reduced to the quantity you confirmed. The original sale is kept. Check the quantity against the broker's statement.
sl: Prodaja je bila zmanjšana na količino, ki ste jo potrdili. Izvirna prodaja ostane shranjena. Količino preverite z izpiskom borznega posrednika.

en: This sale needs a little more than the earlier purchases left, less than 0.00000100 units. The files do not show that it is rounding. Confirm a corrected quantity of the sale or add the missing statements.
sl: Ta prodaja potrebuje malo več, kot so ostali prejšnji nakupi, manj kot 0,00000100 enote. Datoteke ne dokazujejo, da gre za zaokroževanje. Potrdite popravljeno količino prodaje ali dodajte manjkajoče izpiske.

en: The quantity of this sale was not corrected, so it needs more units than the earlier purchases left. Add the missing statements or leave this investment out.
sl: Količina te prodaje ni bila popravljena, zato potrebuje več enot, kot so jih ostali prejšnji nakupi. Dodajte manjkajoče izpiske ali izpustite to naložbo.

en: In a purchase row of this list, the value per unit (F4, 8 decimals) times the units (F3), rounded to 4 decimals, differs from the exact purchase value of those units rounded the same way. The list shows the rounded value per unit; the exact value is kept and nothing is changed.
sl: V nabavni vrstici tega seznama se vrednost na enoto (F4, 8 decimalk), pomnožena z enotami (F3) in zaokrožena na 4 decimalke, razlikuje od natančne nabavne vrednosti teh enot, zaokrožene na enak način. Seznam kaže zaokroženo vrednost na enoto; natančna vrednost ostane shranjena in se ne spremeni.

en: The corrected quantity in the answer to {requestId} must be above zero.
sl: Popravljena količina v odgovoru na {requestId} mora biti večja od nič.

en: The corrected quantity in the answer to {requestId} is above the units that the earlier purchases left. A correction may only reduce the sale.
sl: Popravljena količina v odgovoru na {requestId} je večja od enot, ki so ostale od prejšnjih nakupov. Popravek lahko prodajo samo zmanjša.

en: The corrected quantity in the answer to {requestId} is 0.00000100 units or more below the sale. A correction that large needs supporting data from the broker.
sl: Popravljena količina v odgovoru na {requestId} je za 0,00000100 enote ali več pod prodajo. Tako velik popravek potrebuje podporne podatke borznega posrednika.

en: The corrected quantity in the answer to {requestId} would change the value of this investment by EUR 0.01 or more in total with the earlier roundings. It is not accepted as a rounding correction.
sl: Popravljena količina v odgovoru na {requestId} bi skupaj z prejšnjimi zaokrožitvami spremenila vrednost te naložbe za 0,01 EUR ali več. Ne sprejme se kot popravek zaokroževanja.

en: The reference file {name} is not named payers.csv, relief_statements.csv or broker_payers.csv. The reference data was not loaded.
sl: Referenčna datoteka {name} nima imena payers.csv, relief_statements.csv ali broker_payers.csv. Referenčni podatki niso bili naloženi.

en: The reference file {name} is given more than once. The reference data was not loaded.
sl: Referenčna datoteka {name} je podana večkrat. Referenčni podatki niso bili naloženi.

en: The reference file could not be opened or read. The reference data was not loaded.
sl: Referenčne datoteke ni bilo mogoče odpreti ali prebrati. Referenčni podatki niso bili naloženi.

en: The reference file has a quote that is not closed. The reference data was not loaded.
sl: Referenčna datoteka ima narekovaj, ki ni zaprt. Referenčni podatki niso bili naloženi.

en: A field of the row holds a line break. The reference data was not loaded.
sl: Polje v vrstici vsebuje prelom vrstice. Referenčni podatki niso bili naloženi.

en: The header lacks required columns: {count} ({columns}). The reference data was not loaded.
sl: V glavi manjkajo zahtevani stolpci: {count} ({columns}). Referenčni podatki niso bili naloženi.

en: The column {column} appears more than once in the header. The reference data was not loaded.
sl: Stolpec {column} se v glavi pojavi večkrat. Referenčni podatki niso bili naloženi.

en: The row has a different number of fields than the header (expected {expected}, found {found}). The reference data was not loaded.
sl: Vrstica ima drugačno število polj kot glava (pričakovano {expected}, najdeno {found}). Referenčni podatki niso bili naloženi.

en: The field {field} is empty. The reference data was not loaded.
sl: Polje {field} je prazno. Referenčni podatki niso bili naloženi.

en: The ISIN is not valid (format or check digit). The reference data was not loaded.
sl: ISIN ni veljaven (oblika ali kontrolna števka). Referenčni podatki niso bili naloženi.

en: The ISIN source is not known (ib-edavki, wikidata, issuer, exchange or gleif). The reference data was not loaded.
sl: Vir ISIN ni znan (ib-edavki, wikidata, issuer, exchange ali gleif). Referenčni podatki niso bili naloženi.

en: The country is not 2 uppercase letters. The reference data was not loaded.
sl: Država ni sestavljena iz 2 velikih črk. Referenčni podatki niso bili naloženi.

en: The income kind of a relief statement is not dividend, cash_interest or bond_coupon. The reference data was not loaded.
sl: Vrsta dohodka pri izjavi o oprostitvi ni dividend, cash_interest ali bond_coupon. Referenčni podatki niso bili naloženi.

en: The instrument kind is not share, etf, fund or bond. The reference data was not loaded.
sl: Vrsta instrumenta ni share, etf, fund ali bond. Referenčni podatki niso bili naloženi.

en: The date in verified_on is not a date as YYYY-MM-DD. The reference data was not loaded.
sl: Datum v verified_on ni datum v obliki LLLL-MM-DD. Referenčni podatki niso bili naloženi.

en: The source is not ib-edavki or manual. The reference data was not loaded.
sl: Vir ni ib-edavki ali manual. Referenčni podatki niso bili naloženi.

en: An ib-edavki row has no source revision. The reference data was not loaded.
sl: Vrstica ib-edavki nima revizije vira. Referenčni podatki niso bili naloženi.

en: The broker and code are already in the file. The reference data was not loaded.
sl: Posrednik in koda sta že v datoteki. Referenčni podatki niso bili naloženi.

en: The payer of this dividend is not in the reference files, or you did not pick one of several rows. The report is made without the payer's name, address and country; complete them in eDavki.
sl: Izplačevalca te dividende ni v referenčnih datotekah ali pa niste izbrali ene od več vrstic. Poročilo je izdelano brez imena, naslova in države izplačevalca; dopolnite jih v eDavkih.

en: Foreign tax was paid on some income (dividends and interests) in this form. When you file in eDavki, attach the evidence of the payment and the tax withheld. This app does not attach it.
sl: Za del dohodka v tem obrazcu (dividende in obresti) je bil plačan tuji davek. Pri oddaji v eDavkih priložite dokazila o izplačilu in odtegnjenem davku. Aplikacija jih ne priloži.

en: The payer of this interest is not in the reference files, or you did not pick one of several rows. The report is made without the payer's name, address and country; complete them in eDavki.
sl: Izplačevalca teh obresti ni v referenčnih datotekah ali pa niste izbrali ene od več vrstic. Poročilo je izdelano brez imena, naslova in države izplačevalca; dopolnite jih v eDavkih.

en: An interest payment of zero or less, or one that rounds to 0.00, is not reported and is not netted against other payments.
sl: Obresti v znesku nič ali manj ali take, ki se zaokrožijo na 0,00, niso poročane in se ne pobotajo z drugimi izplačili.

en: This coupon of a Slovenian issuer has tax in the export. A Slovenian payer withholds its own tax, which is not foreign tax and gives no credit. If the payer already withheld the tax on this coupon, leave the coupon out in eDavki; otherwise remove the tax amount.
sl: Ta kupon slovenskega izdajatelja ima v izvozu davek. Slovenski izplačevalec odtegne svoj davek, ki ni tuji davek in ne daje olajšave. Če je izplačevalec davek od tega kupona že odtegnil, kupon v eDavkih izpustite; sicer znesek davka odstranite.

en: The payer of this income is in Slovenia, but the reference files have no valid Slovenian tax number for it. Enter the payer's tax number in eDavki.
sl: Izplačevalec teh dohodkov je v Sloveniji, vendar referenčne datoteke nimajo njegove veljavne slovenske davčne številke. Davčno številko izplačevalca vnesite v eDavkih.

en: Doh-DHO holds only the interest imported here. Add the interest of your other Slovenian and EU banks in eDavki.
sl: Doh-DHO vsebuje samo uvožene obresti. Obresti drugih slovenskih in EU bank dodajte v eDavkih.

en: You claimed the tax treaty with {country} for this interest. Fill in the paragraph and article of the treaty in the claimed rows of Doh-Obr in eDavki; this app does not fill them in yet.
sl: Uveljavljali ste mednarodno pogodbo z državo {country} za te obresti. Odstavek in člen pogodbe v uveljavljenih vrsticah obrazca Doh-Obr dopolnite v eDavkih; aplikacija ju še ne izpolni.

en: The type of this interest or dividend payment is unknown. Say whether it is a dividend, bank-deposit interest, other interest or to be left out of the supported reports. The forms it may belong to are not complete.
sl: Vrsta tega izplačila obresti ali dividende ni znana. Povejte, ali gre za dividendo, obresti na bančni depozit, druge obresti ali naj se izpusti iz podprtih poročil. Obrazci, ki jih zadeva, niso popolni.

en: The question about the type of this interest or dividend payment was cancelled, so it cannot be reported. The forms it may belong to are not complete.
sl: Vprašanje o vrsti tega izplačila obresti ali dividende je bilo preklicano, zato ga ni mogoče prijaviti. Obrazci, ki jih zadeva, niso popolni.

en: You chose to leave this interest or dividend payment out of the supported reports, so it is in no form. Report it yourself if it is taxable.
sl: Odločili ste se, da to izplačilo obresti ali dividende izpustite iz podprtih poročil, zato ni v nobenem obrazcu. Če je obdavčljivo, ga prijavite sami.

en: You chose to leave this payment out of the supported reports, so it is in no form. The file gives no ISIN for its share, fund or bond, which it should have: check the export. Report the payment yourself if it is taxable.
sl: Odločili ste se, da to izplačilo izpustite iz podprtih poročil, zato ni v nobenem obrazcu. Datoteka ne vsebuje ISIN za njegovo delnico, sklad ali obveznico, čeprav bi ga morala: preverite izvoz. Če je izplačilo obdavčljivo, ga prijavite sami.

en: The file has no valid file name, so it was not read.
sl: Datoteka nima veljavnega imena, zato ni bila prebrana.

en: The file is larger than {limitMb} MB and was not read. Check that you chose the right file.
sl: Datoteka je večja od {limitMb} MB in ni bila prebrana. Preverite, ali ste izbrali pravo datoteko.

en: There was not enough memory to read the file. Close other programs and try again.
sl: Za branje datoteke ni bilo dovolj pomnilnika. Zaprite druge programe in poskusite znova.
